mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with risperidone (antipsychotic with serotonergic activity) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and additive CNS depression via monoamine potentiation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms, and ensure adequate washout period (14 days) between agent discontinuation and initiation.
